target_customer: Beginner middle-income retail investors in India
problem: Indian investment apps were built for active investors with thousands of funds to choose from, leaving first-time savers with no simple way to invest.
business_model: Commissions on assets under management plus card interchange fees
product_category: Consumer robo-style investing app with investment-backed credit card

exit.reason: Jupiter, a Sequoia backed Indian neobank, acquired it to expand its user base; price undisclosed.

technical_complexity.rationale: Regulated mutual fund distribution, a conversational portfolio recommender and a card secured by investments needed bank and fund house integrations.

defensibility.rationale: Large players such as Groww and Zerodha Coin could add beginner flows; Easyplan's edge was low acquisition cost and a secured card.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents kept growing; a neobank (Jupiter) bought Easyplan in June 2021 rather than an investing incumbent.

market_need_then: The YC profile cites only about 10 percent of 100 million middle-income workers invested in markets and a pandemic surge in new investors in 2020.

branding.domain_note: Used easyplan.in, a country domain rather than .com.

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive name and no brand evidence beyond launch coverage of the acquisition.

outcome_analysis: Easyplan grew to about 40,000 investing customers by its YC batch on a customer acquisition cost the founders say was 10 percent of the industry average, then was acquired by neobank Jupiter in June 2021, which reported over 250,000 users. The directory marks it Inactive because it was absorbed rather than shut down. Price is undisclosed, so whether this was a strong exit or a soft landing is not known.
notes: easyplan.in returned 503 at research time. Funding totals conflict across aggregators (CB Insights 150K over 3 rounds, TheCompanyCheck about 225K, StartupBlink 300K); none verified, so no rounds are recorded. Investors named by aggregators include Y Combinator and Village Capital. The YC page status is Inactive while sources say acquired by Jupiter, which is reconciled in the exit field. The competitor search returned only current listicles, so no dated 2020 competitor list was recorded. Founder education comes from a single MicroSave line.
